svg.title: More right answers for fewer credits
svg.desc: Right figure, basis named, out of 24 questions, one bar per configuration, best first: Generated tools, gap-filled view: 24 of 24 · 0.020 credits per turn; Generated tools, raw tables: 22 of 24 · 0.020 credits per turn; Skill, script computes: 20 of 24 · 0.097 credits per turn; Hand-written semantic view: 19 of 24 · 0.055 credits per turn; Autopilot semantic view: 19 of 24 · 0.069 credits per turn; Skill, agent writes queries: 19 of 24 · 0.081 credits per turn; Generated semantic view: 19 of 24 · 0.104 credits per turn. The two with generated tools are highlighted.

svg.text: More right answers for fewer credits
Right figure, basis named, out of 24 questions
One run per question: counts, not rates. The raw-table version replayed the
same questions after the campaign. Credits: the agent's AI Credits, billed, median
per turn; the warehouse is billed apart.
